statement: Conditional helper proposal inspected, unreviewed. Native offline calibration of the specified measured-strain ODE using retained384 bracket states predictsR1000=.03725 andR2000=.02646 versus recorded.04969,.03824: roughly25-31% low, failing its required5% calibration replay gate. The local erf profile fits but measured central strain with a shared upstream curve does not predict the observed width/rate dynamics. This rejects that simple closure before neweta validation; no coefficients may be silently rescaled within it. A separate exploratory effective-width-budget diagnostic inferred from width derivatives (not fitted rates) gives common stage-dependent effective thinning larger than measured linear strain, suggesting nonuniform-flow/finite-geometry contributions; it remains unrecorded and uncommitted, not a supported repair.
